verdict.rationale: Bevy has no pricing to reprice. Its first-party docs promise it is "free and open-source forever" under MIT or Apache 2.0, with no contracts, license fees or sales cuts. A 2020 community comment praising the MIT license and a 2026 crates.io probe still reporting 'MIT OR Apache-2.0' show the terms have held from early releases to 0.19.1. Missing for 10: an explicit documented policy on retroactive license or pricing changes, and an independent history or analysis of the license's stability beyond these two data points.

support.subject: As a studio lead, the pricing and license terms have a track record of stability — no retroactive changes that reprice games already shipped
